$comment: The look of the game UI in one place (docs/theme.md). Dark blue and strong yellow. 'palette' holds every colour once; 'ui' gives each colour a job and is what the client uses. Change a colour here, never in code.

buttons.$comment: Kinds of buttons. primary: the one main action per screen (FIGHT, START, TAKE). icon: round symbol buttons. secondary: outline only. Locked buttons use 'lockedAlpha'.

comic.$comment: The hand-inked look of the UI (docs/theme.md): a plain frame in a darker tone of the surface, and ink hatching low on buttons, cards and popups that rises from left to right. hatchSlant: strokes x per y (1 = 45 degrees); hatchTilt: how much the shading edge rises to the right. press: scale while a button is held. Sizes in points.

rarity.$comment: Mapped onto the art palette (docs/style.md); epic is the one colour the art palette does not have.

tagFill.$comment: Fill of an item tile by its first type, so types can be told apart while items have no pictures.
